faq.title: A Few Things to Know Before We Arrive
faq.description: Straight answers about scheduling, pricing, qualifications, and the work we handle.

items.question: Can you come out today?
items.answer: Often, yes. Priority availability depends on current emergencies, location, and the kind of work required.

items.question: Is Blueforge licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. The company and technicians carry the credentials required for the residential work offered.

items.question: What problems can your team handle?
items.answer: We work on water supply, drainage, fixtures, heaters, sewer connections, and common residential plumbing failures.

items.question: Will I know the cost before repair begins?
items.answer: After diagnosis, you receive a clear scope and price for approval before the repair moves forward.

items.question: What is the fastest way to schedule?
items.answer: Call for an active leak or urgent issue. For planned work, use the request form and include useful photos.
